 SELECT m.uuid,e.*,DATETIME(e._timestamp,m.timezone) AS local_time
 FROM mapping m JOIN `default.events` e ON e.magnet_uuid=m.identifier
 WHERE _timestamp<TIMESTAMP('2026-10-28T00:00:00+00:00')
) , classified AS(SELECT *,CASE WHEN uuid='cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' THEN NOT ((EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=2 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=540 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1080) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=3 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=540 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1080) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=4 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=540 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1080) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=5 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=540 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1080) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=6 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=540 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1080) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=7 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=600 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1020) OR (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM local_time)=1 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))>=780 AND (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM local_time)*60+EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM local_time))<1020)) ELSE NULL END AS outside_hours FROM e)

WITH mapping AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid,'cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS identifier,'America/New_York' AS timezone),STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid,'caycecove' AS identifier,'America/New_York' AS timezone),STRUCT('cc455e16-1e6c-4a23-9ffc-6b663589ff08' AS uuid,'@caycecove' AS identifier,'America/New_York' AS timezone)])), e AS (
 SELECT m.uuid,e.*,DATETIME(e._timestamp,m.timezone) AS local_time
 FROM mapping m JOIN `default.events` e ON e.magnet_uuid=m.identifier
 WHERE _timestamp<TIMESTAMP('2026-10-28T00:00:00+00:00')
) SELECT uuid,COALESCE(NULLIF(details_to,''),NULLIF(`to`,''),NULLIF(details_route,'')) AS route,COUNT(*) FROM e WHERE event_type='button_click' AND parsed_ua_bot IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY 1,2

methodology.tours: Counts of retained open_tour events before cutoff, mapped by UUID, alias and @alias. Repeat opens count. No three-click threshold is applied.
methodology.leads: Saved lead records on canonical tours created before cutoff; no contact details included in this snapshot.
methodology.hours: Published current property website hours, applied retrospectively in America/New_York with DST. Opening included, closing excluded. Holidays and past hours changes not modeled. Office hours use indexed official property pages; main website unavailable at retrieval, so current hours were not independently confirmed.
methodology.next_steps: Unique lead rows with metadata containing appointment date and start time, or explicit Question type with message/reason/notes. Histories deduplicated within each lead. Subsets of captured leads; categories may overlap. Metadata reflects retrieval-time state for leads created before cutoff. Scheduling indicates requests/bookings, not attendance.
methodology.geography: Distinct known locations in all tracked activity with complete country/region/city fields; portfolio locations deduplicated. Top five locations use open_tour events excluding flagged bots and unknown fields, matching dashboard exclusions of Pakistan, Philippines and city Sterling Heights. Provinces/states includes equivalent international regions.
methodology.content: Top three amenities and top one floor plan by button_click route counts (details_to, to, then details_route fallback), excluding flagged bots, overview, montage and form screens. Titles and media type use current configuration and may differ historically. Repeat selections count; no watch-duration/completion inference.
